subject: Pen test report & secure delivery options for Hosted API
messages:
From: Maya Rivera <maya.rivera@fintechcorp.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2026-11-04T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure delivery

Hi Rafael,

We are preparing our vendor risk review for Q4 and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API environment (public API endpoints + authentication). Our security team requires: scope, high/medium/low findings, remediation status, and any compensating controls.

A couple of questions:
- Can you confirm whether the report includes external network testing against the public API (not customer tenant data)?
- What redaction level do you apply for customer-identifying data?
- What secure transfer options do you support (S3 presigned, SFTP behind VPN, ShareFile/Box, encrypted archive via password exchange)?

We prefer an automated transfer (presigned link with short TTL) if that meets your policy, otherwise SFTP or an encrypted bundle will work. Can you also provide an expected timeline? We need this by 2026-11-10 if possible.

Thanks,
Maya Rivera
Security Operations
FinTech Corp

Attachments: PO_attachment_placeholder.pdf (purchase order reference)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rivera <maya.rivera@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure delivery

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and timeline. Quick answers up front and next steps below.

Scope: Our latest pen test (conducted 2026-10-01) covered external network testing against the Hosted API public endpoints, authentication flows (API keys + OAuth token exchange), and a small set of infrastructure components (eg. edge WAF, load balancer). It did NOT include customer tenant data or on-prem Dedicated environments.

Redaction: We provide a redacted report for external distribution that removes customer-identifying artifacts and raw request/response samples. Full unredacted reports are only shared under NDA/contract terms and with a documented justification.

Transfer options we support:
- S3 presigned PUT/GET (recommended): short TTL (24–72h) with IP restriction available if you provide an IP allowlist.
- Secure SFTP (AWS Transfer) behind a temporary VPN tunnel / jump host: we can provision a one-time user and rotate creds after transfer.
- Encrypted ZIP (AES-256) with password shared out-of-band (phone or secure chat).
- Managed content platform (Box/ShareFile) via an invite to your security mailbox.

Timeline: I can provide the redacted report via presigned S3 link within 24 business hours once you confirm the preferred method and any IP restrictions. If you require the unredacted report, we need a signed NDA and security contact; delivery then depends on legal review (typically 3–5 business days).

I attached a short sharing guide (pt_sharing_instructions_v1.pdf) that outlines TTL, IP restrictions, and audit logging for each option.

Next step: reply with which transfer option you prefer and (if presigned) any IP allowlist or strict TTL requirement. If you prefer SFTP/VPN, please share the jump-host details and a username to provision.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: pt_sharing_instructions_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-04T17:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure delivery

Rafael / Monica — forwarding Maya's request. Two quick internal items:
1) Can Security confirm the redaction level for the external report we distribute to customers? We typically remove tenant identifiers and raw session dumps; summarise PoCs as high-level descriptions.
2) Monica, please confirm remediation status for the three high-risk items called out in 2026-10 scan (routing misconfig + legacy TLS issue + one auth bypass); sales is asking for a short remediation statement.

I'll approve presigned S3 for distribution by default unless customer requests otherwise.

- Laura
Head of Customer Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T21:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure delivery

Thanks — confirmed. Redaction policy: tenant identifiers, API keys, raw request/response payloads, and attacker IPs are redacted for external distribution. PoCs are summarized to the essential steps but we remove reproducing exploit code.

Remediation status (high-level statement we can share):
- Routing misconfiguration: fixed 2026-10-06, verified in 10/12 follow-up scan.
- Legacy TLS cipher acceptance: mitigated via config update on 2026-10-15, no longer accepted in edge layer.
- Auth bypass (reported): mitigated with a patch and additional token validation; verification scheduled for 2026-11-08 and will be documented in a short remediation addendum.

I will bundle the redacted report and a one-page remediation summary for distribution.

- Monica
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation_summary_2026-11-04.txt

Attached: pt_report_redacted_v2026-10-01.pdf (redacted), pt_sharing_instructions_v1.pdf (transfer log + audit expectations), remediation_summary_2026-11-04.txt (one-page remediation note).

Delivering this afternoon and will follow up with the presigned link.
